description_en: Manages operation orders for digital SMS signatures
description_zh: 数字短信签名操作订单
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi create-digital-sign-order --order-type CREATE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN --submitter 110000001750080 --sign-name '阿里云商城' --qualification-id 41 --qualification-version 49 --order-context '{"qualificationLegalPersonName":"张三","qualificationAdminName":"李四","qualificationCompanyName":"阿里阿巴","qualificationLegalPersonIDCard":"110105199001011234","qualificationOrganizationCode":"91330106MA2A0XABCD","qualificationAdminIDCard":"11010519900101****"}' --sign-industry 0 --sign-id 80 --sign-source 0 --extend-message example --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDigitalSignOrder

parameters.help_en:
Required. The request type. Specifies the operation to perform on the signature based on the enumerated values. Valid values:
UPDATE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN: Updates the signature.
DELETE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN: Deletes the signature.
CREATE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN: Creates the signature
parameters.help_zh:
必填。请求类型，按照枚举类型进行签名管理的新增、编辑、删除操作。
UPDATE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN（更新）
DELETE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN（删除）
CREATE_DIGITALSMS_SIGN（创建）
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The signature name. This parameter is required when you create, update, or delete a signature.

Only pure Chinese, Chinese and English, Chinese and numbers, or English and numbers are supported. The length must be 2 to 16 characters.

Input limits:
Special characters are not allowed, including but not limited to "$, &, %, #, @, !, ^, *, (, ), _, +, -, =, {, }, [, ], |, , :, ', ", <, >, ,, ., /, ?, ~, semicolon, and `".
Pure English letters are not supported.
Pure numbers are not supported. Spaces are strictly prohibited, whether single or multiple consecutive spaces.
Emojis are not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
签名名称。创建/更新/删除当前字段必填。

仅支持纯中文、中英文、中文+数字、英文+数字组合输入，字符长度限制2~16字符以内。

输入限制规则：
禁止任何特殊字符输入，包括但不限于 “$、&、%、#、@、!、^、*、(、)、_、+、-、=、{、}、[、]、|、;、:、'、"、<、>、,、.、/、?、~、`” 等特殊符号
不支持纯英文字母输入
不接受纯数字输入严格禁止输入空格，无论是单个空格还是多个连续空格
不允许输入emoji
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en:
The qualification information. This parameter is required when you create a signature. It is also required when you update a signature and need to change the qualification information.
qualificationCompanyName: the enterprise name. Only the middle dot (·), Chinese brackets ([], ()), English parentheses (()), and spaces are supported. Other symbols or pure numbers are not allowed. The length cannot exceed 150 characters.
qualificationOrganizationCode: the unified social credit code of the enterprise (18 digits). Only the 18-digit code consisting of numbers and uppercase or lowercase English letters is supported.
qualificationAdminName: the name of the handler (in Chinese) or the legal representative.
qualificationAdminIDCard: the ID card number of the handler (18 digits). Only ID cards are supported. The data validation format is the ID card format (18 digits consisting of numbers and letters).
qualificationLegalPersonName: the name of the legal representative or the handler.
qualificationLegalPersonIDCard: the ID card number (18 digits). Only ID cards are supported. The data validation format is the ID card format (18 digits consisting of numbers and letters)
parameters.help_zh:
资质信息，在这个结构中，在【创建】时必填，【更新】时需要变更资质信息则必填
qualificationCompanyName：企业名称。符号仅支持中点·、中文【】（）、英文()及空格，不可含其他符号或纯数字，长度不超过150字符
qualificationOrganizationCode：企业社会信用代码（18位），仅支持统一社会信用，18位数字或大小写英文字母组成的代码
qualificationAdminName：经办人姓名（中文），法定代表人姓名。
qualificationAdminIDCard：经办人身份证号（18位）当前只支持身份证，数据校验格式为身份证格式（数字+字母 18位）
qualificationLegalPersonName：法人姓名/经办人姓名。
qualificationLegalPersonIDCard：身份证号（18位） 当前只支持身份证，数据校验格式为身份证格式（数字+字母 18位）
parameters.name: order_context

parameters.help_en:
The industry type. This parameter is required when you create or update a signature, and is optional when you delete a signature. Valid values:
0: GENERAL.
1: ECOMMERCE
parameters.help_zh:
行业类型
0：通用（GENERAL）；1：电商零售（ECOMMERCE）。
新增/更新签名时，当前字段必填；删除时非必填
parameters.name: sign_industry

parameters.help_en: The signature ID, which is the unique identifier of the signature in the system
parameters.help_zh: 签名ID-系统内唯一签名标识
parameters.name: sign_id

parameters.help_en:
The signature source. This parameter is required when you create or update a signature, and is optional when you delete a signature. Valid values:
0: enterprise or institution.
2: app.
4: e-commerce or flagship store.
5: trademark name
parameters.help_zh:
签名来源   
新增/更新签名时，当前字段必填；删除时非必填。
0：企事业单位；2：App应用；4：电商/旗舰店；5：商标名
parameters.name: sign_source

Data.description_en:
The response body of the API.
signName: the signature name, which is the name of the created signature.
signOrderId: the order ID of the signature, which is the unique identifier of the associated signature order.
signCode: the signature code, which is the unique numeric ID of the signature in the system.
signId: the signature ID, which is the unique numeric ID of the signature in the system
Data.description_zh:
接口返回参数body
signName：签名名称，创建的签名名称
signOrderId：签名OrderId，关联的签名订单唯一标识
signCode：签名编码，签名在系统中的唯一数字ID
signId：签名ID，签名在系统中的唯一数字ID
